scope: Local production research and preview; no commercial-release clearance is claimed.

components.component: InsightFace buffalo_l pretrained detector and landmarks
components.note: The upstream policy explicitly covers both manually downloaded and automatically downloaded pretrained models. A permissive source-code license does not clear these pretrained weights for commercial use.

current_verified_face_backend: Official LatentSync 1.6 FaceDetector directly uses InsightFace detection and landmark_2d_106. No equivalent officially provided replacement backend has been verified in this deployment.
